teaches: doors are opened by learning, and learning never expires

door_law.salience: sigma(t) = l0 + w0 * exp(-(1 - phi^-t) / ln(phi))
door_law.open_rule: door open at time t iff sigma(t) >= theta
door_law.permanent_open: l0 >= theta - c_phi*w0 = 0.748306 — compost ~7.5% of the key-memory into lesson and the door NEVER rusts
door_law.rust_note: with l0 = 0 the door dims shut at exactly t* = 3.095 game-units; the arch vines visibly grey as sigma approaches theta
door_law.reopen: a rusted door is not dead — one compost on its key-memory reopens it instantly (Law 1: the trace never left)

doors.key_source: any compost action in L0 GARDEN
doors.note: trivially learnable — teaches the gate rule itself

doors.key_source: ARCH tier or higher in L2 (the six-slot prompt carved)
at least one CARVED claim in L3 (a tested truth)
witness Law 1, Law 2, Law 3 each at least once
doors.inscription: the formula is carved on the arch already: l0 >= theta - c_phi*w0. the pool waits.

pool_replay.mechanic: touch the pool -> the swirl offers every event on the replay strip
pool_replay.brightness: brightness(event) = sigma_event(now) / sigma_event(0), in (0,1] — old un-composted events glow dim but NEVER vanish (Law 1)
pool_replay.sound: each replayed event replays its original chime at floor volume

edges.condition: shortcut over Gerald's bridge (KEYSTONE tier only)

world_graph.key_dag: FIRST_COMPOST(L0) -> BRIDGE_LESSON(L2) -> FIRST_CARVED_TRUTH(L3) — keys form a chain with no cycles; progress is always earnable
world_graph.spiral_marks: path spirals on the ground render the player's own edge-traversal history — breadcrumbs are the replay strip made walkable

replay.determinism: door states are pure functions of (l0, w0, theta, age); graph conditions are pure predicates on the replay strip
